questions.prompt: Why do the safety rules say to remove metal jewelry?
questions.answer: Metal jewelry has low resistance and increases shock hazards
options: Metal jewelry has low resistance and increases shock hazards
Jewelry raises the resistance of the grounding conductor
Jewelry prevents overload relays from operating
Only magnetic jewelry can create a hazard
questions.explanation: Rings, watches, bracelets, and necklaces can provide a conductive path. The slide connects their low resistance with increased shock hazards.

reviewCue.text: Find “Remove All Metal Jewelry” and the explanation about low resistance.
